keyPoints.en: Badar: 17 Ramadan 2H, about 313 Muslims vs about 1,000 Quraisy; a Muslim victory.
keyPoints.bm: Badar: 17 Ramadan 2H, kira-kira 313 orang Islam lawan kira-kira 1,000 Quraisy; Islam menang.

keyPoints.en: Uhud: Syawal 3H; archers on Jabal Rumah left their post, Khalid al-Walid attacked from behind, Hamzah was martyred.
keyPoints.bm: Uhud: Syawal 3H; pemanah di Jabal Rumah meninggalkan kedudukan, Khalid al-Walid menyerang dari belakang, Hamzah syahid.

tip.en: Badar = faith over numbers; Uhud = obey the leader.
tip.bm: Badar = iman mengatasi bilangan; Uhud = patuhi pemimpin.

keyPoints.en: Khandak (Ahzab), 5H: trench suggested by Salman al-Farisi; the allies withdrew after a strong wind.
keyPoints.bm: Khandak (Ahzab), 5H: parit cadangan Salman al-Farisi; pakatan musuh berundur selepas angin kencang.

keyPoints.en: Hudaibiyah, 6H: 10-year truce; umrah the following year; called a clear victory (al-Fath: 1).
keyPoints.bm: Hudaibiyah, 6H: gencatan senjata 10 tahun; umrah tahun berikutnya; disebut kemenangan yang nyata (al-Fath: 1).

keyPoints.en: Fathu Makkah, Ramadan 8H: caused by Bani Bakar attacking Bani Khuza'ah; about 10,000 Muslims.
keyPoints.bm: Fathu Makkah, Ramadan 8H: berpunca daripada serangan Bani Bakar ke atas Bani Khuza'ah; kira-kira 10,000 tentera Islam.

keyPoints.en: Almost no bloodshed; a general pardon; about 360 idols destroyed.
keyPoints.bm: Hampir tiada pertumpahan darah; pengampunan umum; kira-kira 360 berhala dimusnahkan.
